description: Check whether a set of numbers won in one of the 3 most recent draws of a game (default: the latest). For "nacional" the numbers are décimo numbers (up to 5 digits, at most 5, pass them as strings to keep leading zeros, e.g. "01755"). For the other games pass the main numbers and, when the game has them, the extra numbers (stars, reintegro, clave...). Returns matches, whether it is a winner and the prize. Only the 3 most recent draws can be checked.

drawDate.description: Optional draw date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be one of the 3 latest draws; defaults to the latest.

extraNumbers.description: Optional extra numbers: Euromillones stars, reintegro in Primitiva/Bonoloto, etc.

game.description: Game slug. Call list_games to see them all. Example: "euromillones".

numbers.description: Main numbers to check (nacional: décimo numbers, up to 5 digits).

name: check_numbers
title: Check numbers against a draw
